title: Attractive Home
subtitle: Luxury Interior Design and Fit-Out Company in Dubai
introHeading: Interior Design and Fit-Out Company in Dubai
introP1: Attractive Home is a Dubai based interior design studio and fit-out contractor delivering complete residential and commercial interiors across the UAE. Since 2013 we have designed and built villas, apartments, offices and retail spaces for clients who want considered design and finishes that hold up over time.
introP2: We work as a single point of accountability. Our architects, interior designers, joinery specialists and site engineers handle concept design, 3D visualisation, technical drawings, authority approvals, procurement and full fit-out execution under one contract. You approve the design once, and the same team builds exactly what you approved.
introP3: Whether you are furnishing a new handover in Dubai Hills Estate, renovating a family villa on Palm Jumeirah or fitting out a commercial space in Business Bay, we manage the project from the first sketch to the final handover.
servicesHeading: Our Interior Design and Fit-Out Services
servicesIntro: Four connected services, delivered by one team, so nothing is lost between the design you approved and the space you receive.
svc1Body: Architectural design and space planning for new builds, extensions and structural reconfiguration. We prepare concept layouts, elevations, full technical drawing sets and the documentation required for municipality and developer approvals.
svc2Body: Concept development, mood boards, material and finish selection, lighting design, bespoke joinery drawings and photorealistic 3D visualisation. You see the finished space before a single wall is touched.
svc3Body: Turnkey fit-out execution covering civil works, MEP, ceilings, flooring, wall cladding, custom joinery, painting, furniture installation and final styling. One contract, one project manager, one handover date.
svc4Body: Custom wardrobes, kitchens, doors, wall panelling and feature units produced to your dimensions. Browse our catalog to preview materials and finishes.
processHeading: From First Consultation to Final Handover
step1Body: We meet at your space or on a call, understand how you live or work, and agree the scope, timeline and budget range.
step2Body: You receive layouts, material boards and photorealistic 3D renders. We revise until the design is right.
step3Body: We produce the full technical drawing set and handle municipality and developer approvals on your behalf.
step4Body: Our site team builds the approved design, with scheduled progress updates and a named project manager throughout.
step5Body: Final snagging, deep clean and styling. We hand over a finished space on the date we committed to.
whyHeading: Design and Build, Under One Roof
why1Body: More than a decade designing and delivering interiors across Dubai and the wider UAE.
why2Body: No coordination gaps between your designer and your contractor. The same team from concept to handover.
why3Body: Costs and dates agreed in writing before work begins, with transparent handling of any variation.
why4Body: Bespoke wardrobes, kitchens, doors and wall panelling produced to your exact dimensions.
areasHeading: Interior Design and Fit-Out Across Dubai and the UAE
areasIntro: We deliver residential and commercial projects throughout Dubai and the wider Emirates. If your community is not listed, message us and we will confirm coverage.
faq1Q: How much does interior design cost in Dubai?
faq1A: Cost depends on the size of the space, the finish level and whether you need design only or design and fit-out. After a free consultation we give you a written scope and a fixed price, so there are no surprises later. Message us on WhatsApp for an indicative range for your project.
faq2Q: How long does an interior fit-out take?
faq2A: A typical apartment fit-out runs six to ten weeks once approvals are in place. Villas usually take three to six months depending on scope and structural work. We confirm the exact programme in writing before signing.
faq3Q: Do you handle municipality and developer approvals?
faq3A: Yes. We prepare the required drawing sets and submit for municipality and developer NOC approvals as part of the project scope, so you do not have to manage that process yourself.
faq4Q: Can you work with my existing furniture?
faq4A: Yes. Many clients keep pieces they love. We design around them and specify new items that sit comfortably with what you already own.
faq5Q: Do you offer design only, without the fit-out?
faq5A: Yes. We can deliver concept design, 3D visualisation and full technical drawings for you to build with your own contractor, although most clients prefer we handle both.
bottomCtaBody: Tell us about your space and we will come back with ideas, an indicative timeline and a clear price. No obligation.
bottomCtaNote: Replies within business hours, seven days a week
